title: Trapping Rain Water
hints: Water standing on top of column i rises to min(highest wall to its left, highest wall to its right), minus height[i] if that is positive. Finding both walls per column by scanning is O(n^2).
Precompute left_max[i] and right_max[i] in two passes: O(n) time, O(n) extra space. That is a fine interview answer; the follow-up is O(1) space.

Two pointers from both ends with running left_max and right_max. Whichever side is lower is settled: its water level is bounded by its own running max because the other side has a wall at least that high. Move that pointer and add its water.
